Office Visit - Follow-up
Patient: Emil Delacroix | DOB: 08/09/1975 | MRN: SYN-3099838
Date of service: 06/09/2025 | Dr. Petra Bellamy, MD

History of present illness:
49-year-old man seen for follow-up of low back pain. Low back pain radiating to the right leg for 18 weeks.

Treatment to date:
Completed 7 weeks of physical therapy and daily naproxen without adequate relief.

History:
Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia.
Medications: metformin 500 mg twice daily; atorvastatin 20 mg nightly.

Review of systems:
Red flag screen negative: denies bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, fever, unexplained weight loss, or history of cancer.

Physical exam:
Back: tenderness over the lower lumbar paraspinal muscles; straight-leg raise positive on the right at 30 degrees.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: right L5 lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI lumbar spine without contrast to evaluate for disc herniation; home exercise program; follow up after imaging.
